apps/client/studio/src/features/captions.reason: TanStack Virtual's useVirtualizer returns a mutable instance, so the compiler skips the hook on purpose; nothing to fix here until the library ships a compiler-compatible API.

apps/client/studio/src/features/channel/.reason: An object URL is an external resource: it is created and revoked as a pair in one effect so StrictMode's double run and unmount both free it, and the only way its value reaches render is state. The compiler compiles the hook; only the lint rule flags the set.

apps/client/web/src/hooks/use-window-row.reason: TanStack Virtual's useVirtualizer returns a mutable instance, so the compiler skips the hook on purpose. The dependency-free useLayoutEffect re-measures the list's offset and row gap after every render on purpose: content above the list moves it without any prop changing, and a same-value set bails out.
